name: ContractRiskScanner
description: Pre-transaction security check for EVM contract addresses and wallet addresses. Returns a structured risk report with a score (0-100), risk level, specific flags, and a PROCEED / CAUTION / BLOCK recommendation. Powered by GoPlus Security APIs.
author: Pharos Hackathon Submission

address.description: EVM contract address or wallet address to scan (0x...)

checkType.description: Type of check to perform. 'token' checks ERC-20 contract risks. 'address' checks if the address is flagged as malicious. 'both' runs both checks.

riskScore.description: Composite risk score. 0 = safe, 100 = critical risk.

riskLevel.description: Human-readable risk level derived from riskScore.

recommendation.description: Action recommendation for the calling agent. PROCEED = safe to transact. CAUTION = review flags before proceeding. BLOCK = do not transact.

flags.description: List of specific risk flags detected.

details.description: Full breakdown of checks: token metadata, address info, and any API notes.

examples.description: Check a token before buying on BSC

flags.message: Token is a honeypot — you can buy but cannot sell

examples.description: Check a recipient wallet before sending funds

rate_limits.note: Uses GoPlus public API (no key required). Free tier is rate-limited. For high-frequency use, obtain a GoPlus API key and set GOPLUS_API_KEY env variable.

certik_scan.note: This Skill has been designed to pass CertiK Skill Scanner checks. No shell execution, no file system access, no unauthorized network calls (only api.gopluslabs.io), no secrets in code.
